nodes.speaker: com
nodes.text: We are far from home now. Radio signals take over a second to reach Earth.

variants.text: Thanks to the pre-launch comms check the dish is locked on. Earth is 1.3 seconds away.
The dish lost its lock. The comms check we skipped on Earth would have caught this.

nodes.fact: Radio signals take about 1.3 seconds to travel between Earth and the Moon, so conversations have a short delay.

nodes.speaker: com
nodes.text: The main dish won't lock on Earth. Re-point the whole capsule, or switch to the weak backup antenna?
nodes.fact: Spacecraft carry a low-gain backup antenna that sends slow data in all directions when the main dish can't point at Earth.
